mathematics.independent_solution: Delta=sqrt(36+9e-8)-6 approximately 7.5e-9 m; lambda=5e-7 m, so Delta/lambda approximately 0.015. I/Imax approximately cos^2(0.015*pi)=0.997781, bright but not an exact maximum.

option_checks.evidence: An exact maximum requires integer Delta/lambda; 0.015 is nonzero and noninteger.
No cross-term requires cos(phase)=0. Here phase approximately 0.03*pi and cos(phase) approximately 0.995562, giving strong reinforcement.
The calculated 0.997781 of maximum intensity is bright and nearly constructive, while strictly below the maximum.
Zero intensity for equal beams requires a half-integer Delta/lambda; 0.015 is not 0.5 modulo an integer.
